intro: Answer three short questions and I will suggest a support format. No contact details needed yet.

mode.label: Frequency
mode.text: Question 1 of 3. How often do you need help?

need.label: Tasks
need.text: Question 2 of 3. What kind of help do you mainly need?

sites.label: Websites
sites.text: Question 3 of 3. How many websites need support?

reasons.one_time: You selected one task for one existing website. A one-time task starts from $75 and includes up to one hour; longer tasks are estimated first.
reasons.content: For regular content changes on one website, Content Support is $149/month with up to 2 hours of content work. Technical maintenance is excluded.
reasons.technical: For ongoing care of one website, Complete WordPress Care is $229/month: updates, backups, monitoring and up to 2 hours of content and small technical tasks. Complex issues require separate review.
reasons.multiple: Standard plans cover one website. Multiple websites need a custom scope and estimate.
reasons.launch: Launching a website requires agreement on pages, materials, hosting and setup. Start with a custom estimate.
reasons.custom: VPS, redesign and complex tasks are outside standard plans. The specialist reviews the request and provides a separate estimate.
reasons.unsure: There is not enough information to recommend a standard plan yet. Describe your task in a request and the specialist will help choose the right format.
